scope: Proposition 9.3 (Remaining excitations) of the manuscript “Quantum Depletion and Momentum Distribution in the Dilute Hard-Sphere Bose Gas” (preprints/Quantum-Depletion-and-Momentum-Distribution-in-the-Dilute-Hard-Sphere-Bose-Gas-October-5-2026/Quantum-Depletion-in-the-Dilute-Hard-Sphere-Bose-Gas.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e8a9907a3ac0811), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 72. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Put QR = PR − P0. Uniformly over normalized, possibly complex, bosonic ground vectors, D∥(QR)1Φ∥2 2 ≤ 16ϵj + o(1) + oK(1), (9.12) where ϵj → 0. The coefficient 16 is independent of j; the dilute remainder may depend on j. The exponents u, w and the scale R may be kept fixed when j is increased; all dilute and volume thresholds may depend on j.
